Lowell Public Schools • 155 Merrimack Street • Lowell, MA 01852 • http://www.lowell.k12.ma.us 
 
LOWELL SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
REGULAR MEETING MINUTES 
, 2025 
 
 
 
 
 
Date: November 4, 2026 
Time: 6:30PM 
Location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852 
____________________________________________________________________________________ 
Members of the public can view the meeting via LTC.  Those wishing to speak about a specific agenda 
item must register in advance by emailing the Superintendent.  Please include the agenda item, as well 
as your phone number and email address so we can provide a Zoom link for access. The email address is 
skeo@lowell.k12.ma.us. If you do not have access to email, you may contact us at 978-674-4324. All 
requests must be submitted by 2:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. 
 
 
1. SALUTE TO FLAG 
 
2. ROLL CALL 
 
On a roll call at 6:32 p.m., members present were, namely: Ms. McFadden, Mr. Bahou, Ms. Delrossi 
(Zoom), Mayor Gitschier and Mr. Lay. Mr. Conway and Ms. Martin were absent. 
 
Mr. Peter Cote, LHS Class Senator was also present. 
3. SPECIAL ORDER OF BUSINESS 
 
3.1. Spotlight On Excellence: Student Hero 
The Spotlight on Excellence recognized Ms. Kayla Rivera, a Lowell High School student and true hero. 
While in Florida, Ms. Rivera bravely saved her three-year-old cousin after the child entered the deep end 
of a swimming pool and struggled to stay afloat. She quickly pulled the child to safety and immediately 
administered CPR. Ms. Rivera shared that she learned CPR while attending the Lowell Police Student 
Academy. She spoke highly of the program and expressed how grateful she was to have received this 
valuable training. Her quick thinking and ability to put what she learned into action made a life-changing 
difference.  
4. MINUTES 
 
4.1. The Approval of the Minutes of the Regularly Scheduled Lowell School Committee Meeting of 
October 21, 2026 
 
Mr. Bahou moved to accept and place on file the minutes of the Regularly Scheduled School 
Committee meeting that was held on October 21, 2026; the motion was seconded by Mr. Lay. The 
motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin).
(Page 2 of 3) 
 
Lowell Public Schools • 155 Merrimack Street • Lowell, MA 01852 • http://www.lowell.k12.ma.us 
 
 
5. PERMISSION TO ENTER 
 
5.1. Permission to Enter – November 4, 2026 
 
Mr. Lay moved to approve the Permission to Enter; the motion was seconded by Ms. McFadden. The 
motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
6. MEMORIALS 
 
6.1. Maureen P. Keene, retired paraprofessional from the Morey Elementary School 
 
7. MOTIONS 
 
7.1. [By Fred Bahou]: Motion to have Finance Department include updated Year to Date Expenditure’s 
for the first meeting of every month of all line items in the General fund including original appropriation, 
transfers, revisions, year to date expended, encumbrances, available budget & percentage used based 
on original appropriation. 
 
Mr. Bahou moved to approve; the motion was seconded by Mr. Lay. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 
absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
8. REPORTS OF THE SUPERINTENDENT 
 
8.1. Home Education 
 
Superintendent Skinner recommended that the following parents/guardians be allowed to home 
educate their child:  
Christine Lenihan 
 
Mr. Lay moved to approve Home Education; the motion was seconded by Ms. McFadden. The motion 
passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
9.NEW BUSINESS 
 
9.1. Approval to Accept and Expend Allocated FY27 Awards 
 
These grant funds have been secured by the Lowell Public Schools through the Massachusetts 
Department of Elementary and Secondary Education. 
 
Ms. Delrossi moved to approve, accept and expend the allocated FY27 awards; the motion was 
seconded by Mr. Bahou. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin).
(Page 3 of 3) 
 
Lowell Public Schools • 155 Merrimack Street • Lowell, MA 01852 • http://www.lowell.k12.ma.us 
 
9.2. Letter of Approval for Accepting Donation from the Justin J. Watt Foundation 
 
Lowell Public Schools received a donation of $3,912.79 from the Justin J. Watt Foundation to purchase 
uniforms and equipment for the James J. Sullivan Middle School. The purpose of this donation is to 
support students participating in extracurricular and athletic activities by providing uniforms and 
equipment.  
 
Mr. Lay moved to accept and approve the donation from the Justin J. Watt Foundation; the motion 
was seconded by Ms. McFadden. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
10. CONVENTION/CONFERENCE REQUESTS 
 
10.1. Overnight Out of State Travel Request - LHS to New York, NY 
 
Ms. McFadden moved to bundle & approve convention/conference requests 10.1 through 10.4; the 
motion was seconded by Mr. Lay. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
10.2. Overnight Out of State Travel Request - LHS to White Plains, NY 
 
Ms. McFadden moved to bundle & approve convention/conference requests 10.1 through 10.4; the 
motion was seconded by Mr. Lay. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
10.3. Overnight Out of State Travel Request - LHS to Philadelphia, PA 
 
Ms. McFadden moved to bundle & approve convention/conference requests 10.1 through 10.4; the 
motion was seconded by Mr. Lay. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
10.4. Overnight out of State Request - Community Schools National Network Conference 
 
Ms. McFadden moved to bundle & approve convention/conference requests 10.1 through 10.4; the 
motion was seconded by Mr. Lay. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
10.5. Overnight Out of State Conference Request - ESEA February 2027 
 
Mr. Bahou moved to approve the convention/conference request; the motion was seconded by Ms. 
McFadden. The motion passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
11. ADJOURNMENT 
 
Ms. McFadden moved to adjourn at 7:03 p.m.; the motion was seconded by Mr. Lay. The motion 
passed with 5 yeas, 2 absent (Mr. Conway, Ms. Martin). 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
Liam Skinner, Superintendent and 
Secretary to the Lowell School Committee
